acceptance.behavior: The public signup route creates an account, hands off to email confirmation, and routes the confirmed family role into canonical onboarding.
The role, email, password, confirmation, desktop, and mobile signup states are operable without horizontal overflow.
Supabase Auth durably stores the exact-revision account and its selected canonical role metadata.
Canonical role metadata controls the post-confirmation onboarding destination.
The acceptance spec writes the required exact-revision screenshots, trace, accessibility report, and PBOS result manifest.
One Playwright journey exercises real Supabase signup and confirmed-account onboarding on desktop and mobile.
The mobile confirmation state is scanned for serious and critical axe violations and exports the complete report.
Signup requires an eight-character password, keeps role input canonical, and does not expose provider-specific account errors.
